pack_layer: pack a model layer into QuantLinear format for MXFP or NVFP quantized export
save_quantized_as_fp: save a quantized model in llm-compressor format with MXFP or NVFP data types
get_scheme: get the compressed-tensors format string for a given MXFP or NVFP data type and bit width
get_group_format: get the group format string for MXFP, NVFP, or float quantized layers
build_mixed_fp_quantization_config: build a mixed-precision quantization config dict with per-group format strings for compressed tensors
